journey.name: unified primary wallet
journey.description: Verify the single Bitcoin balance and primary-node entry on an onboarded local build. Start with no primary configured, no hardware wallet paired and USDT disabled. Repeat with a hardware wallet to verify that its separate device balance remains available. This Android flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Open the wallet home screen and verify the total balance (testTag "TotalBalance") is visible
Verify the Savings and Spending cards (testTags "ActivitySavings" and "ActivitySpending") are absent
Tap Primary node (testTag "HomePrimaryNode") and verify the primary-node screen (testTag "PrimaryNodeScreen") opens
Return home, open Receive and verify Bitcoin (testTag "Tab-auto") is selected with an onchain QR even when there is no Lightning channel
Verify there is no Savings tab (testTag "Tab-savings") and no paid Lightning setup or liquidity purchase prompt
Close Receive, open widgets if enabled and verify the Lightning setup suggestion (testTag "Suggestion-lightning") is absent
With a primary configured and notification permission denied, receive a second payment and verify no Get paid passively prompt (testTag "BackgroundPaymentsIntro") appears
When automatic primary funding makes a channel ready, verify no Spending Balance Ready toast (testTag "SpendingBalanceReadyToast") appears and any actual received payment still appears normally
Verify the suggestions do not offer background payments and General settings has no legacy Background payments entry (testTag "BackgroundPaymentSettings") for the primary wallet
With a paired hardware wallet, open its home tile and verify its balance, address and history remain available without a Transfer To Spending button
